title: Kissed Spicy Turkish Chinese Broccoli Kuru Fasulye
description: A Turkish dish featuring Chinese broccoli, with a spicy and mustardy flavor, perfect for a dinner meal. This recipe is sugar-free-friendly and has a fluffy texture.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Add the Chinese broccoli florets to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Grill the broccoli for 5 minutes per side, or until tender.
In a small bowl, mix together the turkish red pepper paste and mustard seeds.
Brush the paste mixture onto the grilled broccoli.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the garlic.
Cook the garlic for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Add the grilled broccoli to the skillet and toss to combine with the garlic.
Serve the Kuru Fasulye hot, garnished with additional lemon juice if desired.
